preset.hy2.description: Base Hy2 QUIC/H3 + TLS. Primary UDP:443 next to Reality. No obfs → demux can match protocol=quic.
preset.hy2.title: Hysteria2
preset.hy2_custom.description: Obfs × bandwidth × masquerade. Salamander breaks demux quic-match — mind :443 stacks.
preset.hy2_custom.title: Hy2 构造器
preset.hy2_gecko.description: Hy2 + gecko obfs (variable size). Stronger DPI randomness, worse for demux classification.
preset.hy2_gecko.title: Hy2 Gecko
preset.hy2_gecko_compact.description: Gecko with a narrow packet window: less overhead, weaker randomness.
preset.hy2_gecko_compact.title: Hy2 Gecko compact
preset.hy2_gecko_masquerade.description: Hy2 + gecko obfs + HTTP decoy on failed auth. Obfs breaks demux quic/SNI match.
preset.hy2_gecko_masquerade.title: Hy2 Gecko + 伪装
preset.hy2_masquerade.description: Bad auth gets an HTTP site response. Does not hide QUIC first-bytes for demux.
preset.hy2_masquerade.title: Hy2 伪装
preset.hy2_masquerade_file.description: 伪装 from an on-disk directory. Needs masquerade_dir.
preset.hy2_masquerade_file.title: Hy2 伪装 file
preset.hy2_masquerade_proxy.description: Hy2 fail-auth HTTP proxied to an upstream URL. Hides bad-password probes; does not change QUIC first-bytes.
preset.hy2_masquerade_proxy.title: Hy2 伪装 proxy
preset.hy2_realm.description: Hy2 via realm control-plane. Needs realm_server_url + realm_id.
preset.hy2_realm.title: Hy2 Realm
preset.hy2_salamander.description: Hy2 + salamander obfs: first-bytes no longer clean QUIC → demux quic/SNI usually fails.
preset.hy2_salamander.title: Hy2 Salamander
